name: Kraan Auto SEO Keyphrase
author: marcelkraan

sections.description:
Kraan Auto SEO Keyphrase is a lightweight, secure, and modern plugin designed to save you hours of manual work. It automatically generates missing Yoast SEO focus keyphrases (using the first 3 words of your post title) and can optionally fill empty Meta Descriptions with the %%excerpt%% tag.

The plugin runs safely in the background via a WP-Cronjob (processing max 50 items per hour) and will never overwrite manually entered SEO data.

Key Features

  • Automatic Background Updates: Safely populates missing SEO data in the background.
  • WooCommerce Support: Works out-of-the-box with Posts, Pages, and WooCommerce Products.
  • Manual Bulk Updater: Search for empty fields (or all fields) and update them in bulk with a visual preview.
  • Highly Secure: Built following strict WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) utilizing nonces, data sanitization, and output escaping to prevent XSS and SQL injection.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kraan-auto-seo-keyphrase folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Kraan Auto SEO to configure your preferences and run manual bulk updates.
sections.faq:
Will this overwrite my existing Yoast settings?

No. The automatic cron job is strictly configured to only update posts where the focus keyphrase or meta description is completely empty. You only have the option to overwrite existing data when explicitly using the manual update tool.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin automatically detects all public post types on your installation, including WooCommerce products.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Fixed PHP parsing issue by replacing alternative syntax colons with standard curly braces.
  • Official stable release with a modern, responsive CSS-grid layout.
  • Fully rewritten using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) to prevent conflicts.
  • Security Hardening: Strict implementation of Nonces, absint(), and esc_html().
  • Added collapsible Help section, WooCommerce documentation, and PayPal integration.
  • Fully translated to English.
